record.original_question: Does there exist a property-(T) II_1 factor whose Haar unitaries form a single sequential commutation orbit in the above sense?

evidence.quote: Problem 24. Does there exist a property (T) II1 factor with unique sequential commutation orbit?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,\tau)$ be a separable II$_1$ factor with faithful normal trace $\tau$, and let $\mathcal{U}_{\mathrm{Haar}}(M)$ denote the set of Haar unitaries in $M$, i.e. unitaries $u\in M$ whose spectral distribution under $\tau$ is the uniform (Haar) measure on the unit circle. Fix a free ultrafilter $\omega$ on $\mathbb{N}$ and form the tracial ultrapower $M^\omega$. Two unitaries $u,v\in M^\omega$ are said to "commute" if $uv=vu$. Define an equivalence relation $\sim$ on $\mathcal{U}_{\mathrm{Haar}}(M)$ by declaring $u\sim v$ if there exist $n\geq 1$ and Haar unitaries $w_0,w_1,\dots,w_n\in \mathcal{U}_{\mathrm{Haar}}(M^\omega)$ with $w_0=u$, $w_n=v$, and $w_{i-1}$ commuting with $w_i$ for every $i=1,\dots,n$. Call the equivalence classes of $\sim$ the sequential commutation orbits of $M$.

Recall that $M$ has property (T) (in the sense of Connes–Jones) if every Hilbert $M$-bimodule that contains almost central tracial vectors must contain a nonzero central tracial vector.

Question: Does there exist a II$_1$ factor $M$ with property (T) for which $\mathcal{U}_{\mathrm{Haar}}(M)$ consists of a single sequential commutation orbit?
artifact.status_search_result: The notion of sequential commutation orbit on Haar unitaries of a II$_1$ factor was introduced in recent work, where it was shown that the relation admits either one or uncountably many orbits, and connections were established with property Gamma and with 1-bounded entropy. The question of whether a property (T) II$_1$ factor can have a unique sequential commutation orbit is listed as an open problem in a recent compilation of 50 open problems on ultraproduct II$_1$ factors, and no resolution appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Sequential commutation in tracial von Neumann algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces the equivalence relation generated by sequential commutation of Haar unitaries in the ultrapower; shows the orbit space has cardinality 1 or uncountable.
status_evidence.claim: Defines the sequential commutation orbit framework underlying the question.

status_evidence.title: Internal sequential commutation and single generation
status_evidence.snippet: Studies single generation and orbit structure for sequential commutation; relates to property Gamma and produces non-Gamma factors with a single orbit.
status_evidence.claim: Provides examples of unique sequential commutation orbit in non-Gamma factors but does not resolve the property (T) case.
